name: Mixdown
summary: Recording studio sign-in: desk meters jump as you type, every mic mutes for your password, ON AIR on success
about: A full sign-in page for a Lahore recording studio, with the form in a rack unit beside a control room: a mixing desk with moving faders and LED meters, two VU meters, a tape machine and a window into the live room. Typing your email drives the meters and the waveform display; the password mutes every channel and pulls the blind down over the live room. A wrong password clips the meters red and shakes the desk, and signing in lights the ON AIR sign and spins the tape.
how: Watch the page run a demo session by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email: the EMAIL fader rises, the meters jump and the VU needles swing
Click the password: every channel mutes and the blind comes down; the eye button solos the password channel
Try a wrong password, or use Fill it in (ali@mixdown.pk, basstone7) to light ON AIR
Create account counts password rules as bars of signal; the reset code is 240716
